title: ChatGPT Sites Hits 5M Pages as Anthropic's Threat Report Goes Viral
tldr: OpenAI's ChatGPT Sites platform passed 5M published sites and shipped faster deploys plus a new GPT-6 Astra prompting guide.
Anthropic's threat report went viral over the weekend (42M views) with new specifics: a Yemen group building missile-stabilization software and a 70-site disinformation network, both shut down.
A ready-to-use ChatGPT prompt turns the model into a salary negotiation coach that builds your opening ask, target, and walk-away point.

tips.heading: Turn ChatGPT into a salary negotiation coach
steps: Open ChatGPT and paste the prompt below, filling in your role, company, location, current offer, and target comp.
Review the leverage assessment, opening ask, realistic target, and walk-away point it returns.
Use the objection-handling responses it drafts to prep for employer pushback.
Take the closing negotiation script it writes into your actual call.
tips.prompt:
Act as a salary negotiation coach. Help me plan a negotiation for:

Role: [job title]
Company: [company]
Location: [location]
Offer: [base + bonus + equity]
Target: [desired compensation]
Key achievements: [2–3 strongest achievements]
Leverage: [competing offer / scarce skills / strong interview feedback]
Minimum acceptable: [amount]

Assess my leverage, recommend an opening ask, realistic target, and walk-away point, and tell me which parts of the package to prioritize. Anticipate likely employer objections and give me concise responses. Finish with a short negotiation script for the call. Do not recommend bluffing or unsupported claims.

tips.heading: Get better-looking output from AI app builders
steps: Feed the tool reference images of the look you want instead of describing it in a text prompt.
Let two or three different LLMs each take a first pass at the initial design, then pick the strongest starting point.

news.body: OpenAI's ChatGPT Sites platform passed 5M published sites. The site-building/hosting tool added teammate collaboration, shareable private sites, and deploys that are 2x faster; OpenAI also published a developer guide, "Rethinking Prompts and Skills for GPT-6 Astra," with best practices for its newest model.
news.means: Worth a look as a fast way to stand up a client-facing prototype or microsite without a dev handoff — and the Astra prompting guide is a quick read if you're already building on that model.

news.body: Anthropic's threat intelligence report went viral over the weekend (42M views), with new specifics on the real-world misuse cases it disclosed: a Yemen-based group used Claude Code to build software stabilizing flying vehicles for ballistic missile development (one of six similar instances found), and a separate influence-as-a-service operation ran disinformation across roughly 70 fabricated websites reaching six continents. Anthropic says it disrupted every operation in the report and shared findings with authorities and other AI labs.
news.means: Good material for client conversations on AI governance and misuse risk — concrete, disclosed cases carry more weight than hypotheticals when you're making the case for guardrails.
